review_description: Sales quoting process was done remotely; this was the same for all suppliers who quoted. With Ultimate there was no pressure, the salesman knew his stuff answering all questions.Installer was excellent talked me through the job before he started, he and his offsider were very polite, tidy, punctual and eager to assist.Customer service was great, once we had given the go ahead everything was taken care of, we didn't have to do anything. Installer downloaded the ap for me set it up and explained how it all worked.They didn't organize the grid connection however they explained everything and gave me the necessary paperwork to manage it myself.

From our first contact we knew that Ultimate Solar Solutions Pty Ltd from Preston’s NSW were the Installers of Choice for Us.They, namely Mark came to our home, one of the key points I requested when filling out our particulars on the questionnaire on Solarquotes to arrange for the three Installer Choices. I wanted to speak face to face and be able to ask questions throughout the process to ensure an outcome that satisfied all parties. Mark was our advisor from the second company referred to us by Solarquotes.The first based in Penrith contacted us by phone, asked us to forward pdf copies of our last 3 power bills and said they would use a view of our roof to design our solar system. No in person contact.The last never even bothered to call. Again no in person contact.Mark was with us throughout the entire process and was there every time we reached out. The design phase saw us being offered four choices being a cheaper and dearer version of a North and East facing Solar Array and a North, East and West facing System. We went with the dearer N, E and W Version and couldn’t be happier with the finished product.Added to the above was a very clever Stackable Battery and a Gateway which gave us instantaneous coverage should the power drop out in a blackout. Our battery covers us from dusk till dawn and to date hasn’t used more than 25% of our battery total. On a sunny day we have fully recharged the battery before Noon and then power the house and send any excess to the Grid.Our Solar Panels ended up numbering 33 in total and allows us sufficient scope to add both a Heat Pump and an EV Charging Station in the years to come. The panels have the added protection of being bird proofed as well as being All Black which looks amazing against our Colourbond corrugated roof in Paperbark. A True Joy to Behold.The installation Team were all hard working professionals who got everything except the bird mesh done in a single day in spite of strong wind and a couple of bouts of rain thrown in for good measure.I can only complement both Finn Peacock and Mark for the amazing feats and support they provide and suggest that anyone planning on adding solar and a battery to their residence can not go wrong if they talk with these two individuals first and foremost. They will certainly steer you well clear of the many pitfalls along the way.To all the people who played a part in making our Dream a Reality, Thank you one and all for everything and Good Luck and Good Fortune to one and all. Stay Safe and Happy.Fondest regards - Darryl and Robyn S

I had a great experience with Ultimate Solar Solutions. The quote they provided was very reasonable—actually cheaper than several other quotes I received. The entire process felt easy right from the start.The installation was excellent. The team that came out was very professional, knowledgeable, and managed to install the 25 panels quickly. Only one tile broke during the installation, which is impressive. Although it was a busy period, they returned to finish off the battery within about a week, rather than the months you sometimes hear about.After the job was finished, there were a couple of minor issues, but they addressed them quickly and without any fuss. I appreciated their reasonable and responsive approach.I have already recommended Ultimate Solar Solutions to friends and family and would happily suggest them to anyone considering solar energy. They are a solid company with good people to work with!
Solar quotes was great at connecting me to my local supplier's

I have my solar system installed by Ultimate Solar Solutions team. So far, I am very happy their work and importantly, they gave me a fair quote with smooth installation.Quoting:- Josh is one of the first person reached out to me. He is very responsive and helped me answered all questions.- He proposed different options and settings and helped me find the best settings for us.- The quote is good and competitive. They were not trying to upsale me. Josh listened to our needs and quoted exactly.Installation:- Our installation were booked 4 weeks after signing the contract.- Scheduling was flexibile, our installation was moved ahead as there was available spot.- Installation happens on time and smoothly.- Installers are in-housePost-installation:- They helped me do paperwork and submit the related paperwork to my provider- One day after making the final payment, the paperwork has been submitted
Had a good friendly crew and flexible when I had to cancel the job. Adjusted the installation plan on site and took care to ensue installation will last rather than just install and go.

Sungrow battery and hybrid inverter installation.Great effort on Ultimate Solar's part. Joseph was very easy to deal with and was very patient and accommodating with my many requests for quotes on multiple scenario's for battery sizes and extra solar panels.I ended up going with a 19.2 kWh Sungrow battery and hybrid inverter connecting to my existing solar panels. At a very competitive price.Not withstanding the installation team being involved in a motor vehicle accident on the day of installation, it all went off without a hitch. Thanks to Daniel and his offsider.Its been in for 2 sunny days now and I haven't used any grid power as yet. It will be interesting when the weather changes again.Very happy with the result.

Very happy with the service that Phillip and his team provided. I asked many questions over many days and Phillip was happy to answer them all.I would recommend Ultimate Solar to everyone, they provided a very competitive price and installation was quick and painless with great communication provided.

Ultimate Solar stood out from the other companies I had spoken to immediately. I was given the time to ask questions and  I felt like the answers I was given were honest and genuine, with no pressure.Site visit, booking and installation were all seamless. It was a quick and efficient service and all of the team that I came into contact with were brilliant.100% recommend using Ultimate Solar

After comparing many quotes, I decided to go with Ultimate Solar Solutions. Overall, I had a great experience with Joesph & the installation team. Joesph took the time to clearly explain our queries, the process and how to maximise the usage. I have recommended this company to family & friends.

First contact was very fast, rep attended and recommendation/quote was quick. I requested some options with different number of panels and prices with and without batteries. We settled on 18 panels and negotiated further on the optimum size of the inverter.Deal was done and they were quick to schedule installation although it was delayed by weather on other projects so ended up a week later than planned.The installation crew were exceptional. Looked after the yard, we’re very friendly and efficient. Negotiated where to put the inverter and make provision for future batteries. Cleaned up when finished. Due to roof dimensions we had to reduce by one panel and this was not an issue. I got a credit for the panel not used.We are connected to the grid but don’t yet have the Smart Meter. I understand it has been arranged.Very happy with all aspects.
My Solar Panels where Trinia and my Inverter is Sungrow which I am very happy with, however I did not purchase the Battery as they wanted $12,000.00 and was just out of reach of my budget.
Neat install by polite crew. Sales were helpful and not pushy.
Everything was great except:- Was advised I could get 5 panels on front roof - then told by installers I couldn't
On site visit, very fast installation and set-upSungrow battery will be added when NSW battery subsidy becomes available in November

Getting the right information about solar has always been a little difficult without being spammed. Spiro at Ultimate Solar was fantastic. He took the time to talk me through the technical, financial and installation aspects and their quote was the cheapest for the same product. Install and communication was seamless and I have since contacted them with clarifying questions which were answered beautifully. Ultimate use their own people- not sub contractors- which also makes me feel very comfortable should I need any post install service. I went and picked up some replacement tiles in case of breakage but they used 2. A great team. Highly recommend.

Punctuality - good. Communication from company was good pre-installation and with communicating necessary changes to installation plan (to react to property design). Post-installation could have been better with follow up on connection to grid, sending install documentation.Electrician installing invertor did not use drop sheets and left a big mess of metal filings, plaster and cabling. Rest of crew tidied up the mess. Lackluster communication from electrician at time of install - how to use the monitoring application. Had to work it out on my own. System running well at this point in time.

The team at Ultimate Solar was our final choice for solar based on the service, system, and package that suited our home. The installation was done professionally, and the app for tracking your system is easy to use. Communication was fantastic, and everything was installed on time. The entire team from sales, admin through to the installers were fabulous.

Jason from Ultimate Solar informed me about my different options and helped me find the right solution that suited my house. He was so polite, and kept me updated about everything. Beautiful customer service from them all. The boys who did my installation were so nice, and did a clean job. They went through the app and showed me what they did, and allowed me to connect backup switches as well. Would recommend. Went with a Sungrow 12.8 battery + inverter and it's been working like a charm with amber for batteries.

Very Knowledgeable and easy to understand salesperson (Jason), provided me with 2 quotes for different branded panels and also quoted for a heat pump hot water system in lieu of my off peak system. The installation guys were very punctual, neat, tidy and very competent at their jobs and really in comparison with other quotes I received they provided what I wanted and needed for a very reasonable amount.
Very happy with our installer. Sales and quoting process no problem. Installed in a day no problem.
Best value quote was given, installation was done on day given, they cleaned up after themselves & arrived at time given.Ultimate put in all paperwork required for grid connection after the install

Super happy with the entire experience with Ultimate Solar. Ultimate were very clear/supportive through sales/quoting and pre-installation. Installation was excellent, took most of one day, team was very professional. Post install support excellent.
My system has not yet been installed but Ultimate Solar were very responsive to my requirements.

Ultimate Solar Solutions lives up to its namesake. I dealt with a very informed and courteous man named Joseph. He quoted me a great system with a great price based on our needs and roof type. The quotation itself was more detailed, informative and it has web links to videos and information on all the products quoted in it. Super handy and useful. There is a chart outlining the expected amount of power generated in a typical year and the ROI time. All packaged in an easy to understand format with no difficult jargon or terminology.The installation team installed the 8kW system on a rainy day promptly and without delay. They did a very clean and tidy install. They also helped to install a Tesla charger in my garage and commisioned it.They were all polite, punctual and cleaned up after the job was done. Couldn't recommend these guys enough. 5 stars all the way from start to finish.

The team at ultimate solar were incredibly helpful and answered all of my questions as they came up while I was researching solar systems. The team was very patient with me while I made my decision.The installation was quick and earlier than expected.Some minor issues after installation that were able to to be fixed remotely.

Ultimate Solar Solutions recently installed a 10.2 kw system on my house. Joseph helped me throughout the process with all of my questions (and there were many!). The system was installed earlier than expected and is working very well. They were competitive on price and the workmanship was top notch. I would highly recommend them
All good. I am happy with the system and process.
Everything from start to finish was delivered in full & on time as proposedGreat everything all round …
Great company to deal with, professional, honest and great pricing.

I recently had a 13kW solar system installed by Ultimate Solar, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. From start to finish, the process was smooth and efficient. The installers were not only friendly but also highly experienced, completing the entire installation in just one day. Additionally, Joseph, the sales agent, was incredibly helpful and knowledgeable during the planning stage. Overall, Ultimate is a reliable company with a commitment to quality workmanship. I highly recommend them for anyone considering solar installation.

We sought three quotes from solar quotes for our solar installation. Ultimate solar were the first to give me a call rather than just an email (and answer all my hundreds of questions) and the only one who actually asked what budget we had before putting together a tailored plan.They were never pushy and were upfront and honest about everything, even their capacity for  installations before Christmas so we knew how long we would need to wait. We were surprised and delighted when they were able to offer us an earlier installation date due to another customer having to delay. The installation was quick and easy and support from the team afterwards was great, we didn't have to do a thing.
I was happy with the process.The process of installation was excellentCustomer service was great as well

Our scheduled installation was brought forward by a month. The guys arrived promptly and despite some rain completed the job in a day. They kept us well informed throughout the whole process and cleaned up after themselves. We had a few issues with the iSolarCloud app but with great Customer Service it has hopefully now been resolved.The sales/quoting process was excellent with everything being carefully explained to us. We’d had a couple of other quotes but the friendly sales process made our decision to go with Ultimate that much easier.

Joseph from Ultimate Solar really made the solar purchasing experience a pleasant one. No question was ever too much and he even rang me back the day before New Year’s Day to help me with question I had. We went through 3 different variant's with different solar components before I finally settled on one. We booked in the install and that was that.Got a call from Solar Quotes a whole month early saying they could install that week! Was very happy and jumped at the chance. On the day the guys arrived on time and were nice and friendly. They gave me a quick outline of what was going to happen and they were off. The whole system was able to be installed in a single day which I was very happy about. They also ran me through the inverter app and made sure all was working before they left. The install was nice and neat and conduit pipe work nicely routed.After install they submitted the solar paperwork to my energy supplier to advise them of the addition on our behalf. They also provide 1 year free of Solar Analytics which I received access to shortly after. The only minor issue after the fact was my consumption monitoring wasn’t working properly on Solar Analytics for a few days. As soon as I notified them of this they were on the case and were able to remotely fix the issue. All is working fine now.Overall I am very happy with the install. Their quote was the most competitive out of all the ones I received and they used quality reliable components that fit my budget. Will be recommending them to friends and family.

I had the pleasure of working with two sales representatives from Ultimate Solar Solutions Pty Ltd. Spiro got in touch with me first after getting my referrals through Solarquotes. He was patient explaining differences between options for panels and inverters, and worked with me to come up with the most suitable one for our needs. What set the company above the others was that the sales reps also have trades knowledge, and was able to explain patiently the technicalities of the system as well as the installation process to address my questions and concerns, no matter how many questions I came back to them with.Coming closer to the installation date, Jason gave us amazing customer service when he proactively rescheduled the job to the earliest availability to accommodate our roof restoration and to work around the recent rains. I barely noticed they were there. There was only one issue during installation, which the team quickly addressed within an hour with the best available solution without changing the cost of the system. We love that Ultimate Solar also arranged with our electricity provider for a meter reconfiguration on our behalf. However, I wished the process that happens after the installation could have been better communicated, but maybe it was due to the bottleneck created by the end of the year and the recent rains in Sydney? Regardless of the small hiccups, it was a pleasant experience working with Ultimate Solar from start to end.

Great chatting to Spiro about solar, very informative and an easy quoting process. Ended up proceeding due to competitive pricing, excellent support, quality materials and being able to fit in an early install date. Install job took roughly half a day and the guys were punctual with nothing to fault. System is up and running with no issues so far - overall a fantastic experience.

Fantastic salesman no bull straight talker didn’t try snd sell me what I didn’t need like other companies did best price of all the companies I got quotes from installers very professional and quick to install
Sales person came to house so was able to provide perfectly customised quoteGood customer serviceVery reasonable quoteReliableInstallation quick and efficient

I would recommend Ulitimate solar given my recent experience. As with any purchase, some issues did occur, however still keeping a five star rating as they were quickly rectified (arrangements were immediately made to repair some damage to the roof & very quick support to fix the analytics tool that was part of instal). The system is working perfectly and i am a very satisfied customer….
All good so far. No problems as yet. Job was neatly carried out.
As I said up could be a log in problem however no one has shown me how to fix it.
Knowledgeable and professional service from start to finish. Installation was fast and clean

Recently had Ultimate Solar Solutions install a 10kW system at our house. Spiro was very helpful and patient, answering the myriad of questions I had. The installation went without a hitch. The lads were efficient and cleaned up thoroughly upon completion of works. Spiro followed up and made sure I was happy with everything, and took the time to explain what to expect moving forward, how to use the app etc.Totally satisfied with the whole experience and would recommend this business

I found Ultimate Solar through Solar Quotes. Spiro spent 2 hours explaining the nuances of the solar technology, the installation process, analytics of how it would be expected to perform and even offered advice on the best value retail plan on the market for solar customers. The installation was seamless, the panel generation is great and I have two apps on my phone giving real time data on how much the panels are generating compared to my usage. This is all at a cost lower than I was quoted from other suppliers. Highly recommend.

Sales quoting process was very pleasant, informative & professionalInstallation was punctual , tidy, professional and very efficient. I hardly felt their presence.Customer service from inception until delivery was very professional, pleasant.I will not hesitate to recommend them to friends and family

I can genuinely vouch for ultimate solar and would recommend to everyone looking to have solar installed. Jason was fantastic to deal with and even went in lengths to cater to have it installed before our newborn was due. In addition,  although the initial quote was already better than the competitors, Jason worked with me to come up with a system that met my budget without loosing too much on the total output. Not only the workmanship was perfect, the guys were incredibly thorough and left the place clean. Honestly, I cannot thank Jason and his team enough for such a superb job.

I would like to thank solarquotes for helping out as I no idea what to look for I got 3 quotes within 4 days and choose ultimate solar solutions for there price and their honesty. Jason was a huge help from the layout to what I needed and explained it so I could understand how it will all work. Danny and his team were awesome in the installation everything was on time and smooth and also explained everything from the inverter to the app it uses, was very happy with ultimate solar solutions and would recommend to anyone.
Great customer service, very informative and answered any questions. install when smoothly and is very neat
Sales was friendly and helpful. Always called back, still waiting for meter to be sorted from electricity authorities before I can rate the performance of the system
1 Good2 Polite3 Solar was running as soon as the installation was finished

Solar quote was easy and informative. Installation wait time was quick and the entire installation was done within a day. Grid connection and application for a smart meter were fully organised for us. Post-installation support was responsive and helpful.

Going through the quoting process was straight forward and really helpful. They were the only company to actually listen to what my needs and wants were out of a solar setup and provide a quote that matched that.Installation was smooth and the guys were very friendly and professional.All along the way there was great communication and support from the Ultimate Solar team.

After much research and numerous quotes I chose to go with one of Solar Quotes recommended installers - Ultimate Solar Solutions and what a great decision it was. Their Operations Manager provided me with various options and quotes and was exceptionally helpful in answering all of my questions re. panels, inverters etc. Their quotes were very competitive and the quality of the workmanship was first class.  The installation was completed quickly and efficiently and my site was left spotless after they had completed the work. I can highly recommend them to anyone looking to go solar and will be letting my family and friends know what a great job they did. Again a big thank you to the team at Ultimate Solar Solutions. From a very happy & satisfied customer.

HIGHLY RECOMMEND! From the start, the entire process was amazing thanks to Jason, Danny and the team! Jason was fantastic to deal with and answered all our questions, he worked very closely with us to spec a system which actually delivers within our budget. Other quotes we received (over 5 quotes from some big companies) were cookie cut systems not taking into consideration our roof at all.Our installers on the day were unbelievable, friendly and polite and over delivered at the end of the day, whenever someone sees our installed system today, they are always praising the installers for such great work they did.Ultimate solar is our only recommendation to everyone who asks us about solar.

Since we had some bad experience with our previous solar system of 10 years ago, I did a lot of research this time around and the guys from Ultimate Solar are so patient with me as we went through all the details to design a suitable system. After 2 months of a lot of unfortunate events (rain storm, covid, supply shortage, unregistered STC from one of the suppliers, price changed), we finally have our solar system installed. It's a beautiful REC Alpha Pure with SolarEdge inverter and optimisers.SolarEdge inverter and optimisers seems to have some bugs with their apps in the first week but Ultimate Solar guys have contacted and worked with the tech guys from SolarEdge to sort out some little issues and since then everything seems to be in order. Even in cloudy sky of Winter, we can harvest a lot of energy from the sun and cut down the power from the grid to zero during the day plus excess power to feed back to the grid.Highly recommend Ultimate Solar Solutions.

Dan, Jason and the team did an excellent job answering all my questions pre-installation. They also gave me an excellent price on the install. Actual installation was seamless and Dan helped me out setting up the software monitoring app and also arranged the feed-in coordination with my power provider. Overall a really good experience

After spending several months researching solar, we decided on a local reputable installer rather than a large sales company and I am so glad we did. The service and quality installation from Dan and his team was flawless.  Dan worked with us to determine the largest size system we could fit on our roof space that meets compliance (even though we wanted to go bigger and other companies offered to squeeze a larger system onto our roof it was just not possible).  We did encounter some unforeseen delays due to covid and shipping but totally understandable during these challenging times. We just got our first quarterly bill (even though the system was only installed for half of the quarter) and happy to say it was $650 cheaper.  If you are in Sydney and thinking of getting a solar quote please consider Jason, Dan and The Ultimate Solar team, you won't be disappointed.

Sales/quoting process was easy, Ultimate solar were easy to deal withInstallation was challenging with lockdowns, delays with parts, bad weather all affecting the installation, but we were kept advised of when our install date would be. The team were polite, helpful, tidy and *relatively* punctual.Customer service was good also, grid connection was done but our energy provider have been slow changing the meter to a smart meter.

Stunning customer service , excellent product , amazing advice , the whole team done a job without any issues or hassle , recommended team to be installing your next solar panels on your roof.Very happy customer.

Jason was my first point of contact when I initially contacted Ultimate Solar Solutions, this was during the design phase of build my house over 12 months ago. Jason guided me through the process of selecting suitable panels and inverter for my price range. He was also able to give advice on the best panel orientation to maximize the solar usage specifically to my own personal needs.When it came to instillation, Dan contacted me and gave further technical advice on the panels, inverter and monitoring system that I had chosen. Instillation was competed quickly with no issues. My system is performing well above expectations. The whole process was flawless from start to finish. I could not recommend the team at Ultimate Solar Solutions highly enough.

I received my quote from Jason, he provided a number of options with lots of information relating to the hardware proposed and ROI. We had a conference call and he explained in detail all the options and pricing, he was knowledgeable and patient with all my questions.We scheduled the install for roughly three weeks after deciding to go ahead. The date of install comes around and Danny turns up bright and early with his team ready to go, they had to remove an old solar install first, which they did carefully and efficiently. Danny checked in with me every now and then to make sure I didn't have any questions or concerns. The install was completed with no issues, it was obvious they took their time to make sure everything was done correctly and the site was left spotless, Danny provisioned the system and helped me understand the app, he was happy to stay for as long as possible after the install to ensure all my questions were answered. Big props to Danny, he seems really passionate about Solar Technology and gives you confidence that not only you will be looked after during the install but also if you ever need support in the future.I highly recommend the team at Ultimate Solar, top notch professionals from start to finish.

Ultimate Solar were more than willing to price several options so that i could easily compare. Polite and professional sales and installation teams. Highly recommend for your next install, can't go wrong.
Brilliant energy Consultant and friendly install team. My solar system brought my bills down to almost $0 on the first quarter.
The guys did a great job and in a timely manner.Highly recommend
